summary: The sum is Tr_{E/K}(xȳ). Since α⁻¹x, α⁻¹y are integral and α·ᾱ·P′(ζ) is a unit at every finite place, xȳ·P′(ζ) is an integer of E; as P′(ζ) generates the relative different of E/K, xȳ lies in the inverse different and its trace lies in 𝓞_K.

steps.claim: It suffices to show Tr_{E/K}(x·ȳ) ∈ 𝓞_K: by `coe_trace_eq_sum` the trace of x·ȳ is ∑_τ Φ_τ(x·ȳ) = ∑_τ Φ_τ(x)·conj(Φ_τ(y)) (E is a CM field, Φ_τ(ȳ) = conj Φ_τ(y)).

Tr_{E/K}(x·ȳ) ∈ 𝓞_K. The relative different of E/K is generated by P′(ζ) ≠ 0 (`relDifferent_spec`), and an element whose product with the different is integral has integral trace (the different criterion). Here x·ȳ = (x·ȳ·P′(ζ))/P′(ζ) and x·ȳ·P′(ζ) is integral: its image in the finite adeles is (α·ᾱ·P′(ζ))·(α⁻¹x)·conj(α⁻¹y), a product of a unit at every finite place (`v_alpha_mul_relDifferentGen`) and two integral adeles.
